notesEn: • 8.1.2 — UISHADOW, AVATAR RIGS & PATH2D FILL: • New ui_shadow with native Upgraded UIShadow (Mode=Shape/Text, Inset, Knockout, child UIGradient) and Color3 contrast APIs. • New Avatar tools: search_avatar_catalog, inspect_avatar_item with rendered thumbnails, and build_rig (R6/R15, 11 standard templates, bundles, classic & 3D layered clothing, accessories). • ui_path approximately fills closed curves with fill=true. • ui_audit checks shadow budget (<=100). • Bridge remains an unpublished candidate.
